decisions.reason: The reference electrometer sits close to the firm's core dosimetry and calibration business and is featured on the home page, and the firm is expanding in a growing industry, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The oncology risk management software fits the strategy of converging machine and patient QA and has its own page, and although its early results are uncertain, the slack from an expanding firm lets management carry it rather than drop it after one year.
